reviews.text:
I have tried many cleansing oils over the years, but the ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil is truly in a league of its own. For someone with mature, dehydrated skin, finding a product that removes stubborn makeup and sunscreen without compromising the moisture barrier is essential—and this delivers every single time.
Why it’s a staple in my routine:
 Deep yet Gentle Cleansing: It effortlessly melts away everything—waterproof mascara, heavy-duty SPF, and daily grime. It gets into the pores and dissolves everything without any harsh scrubbing.
 Non-Stripping Finish: Unlike other oils that can leave the skin feeling tight or leave a greasy residue, this one rinses off completely clean. It leaves my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and perfectly balanced, which is crucial for my skin type.
 Nutrient-Rich Formula: I love that it’s packed with nourishing ingredients like fermented grain extracts, argan oil, and jojoba seed oil. It feels more like a skincare treatment than just a makeup remover.
 Non-Irr
reviews.zh:
多年嚟我試過好多卸妝油，但係 ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 真係獨一無二。對於膚質成熟、缺水嘅皮膚嚟講，要搵一款可以卸走頑固彩妝同防曬，又唔會損害皮膚保濕屏障嘅產品，係必須嘅——而呢款每次都做得到。
點解佢成為我日常必備嘅原因：
 深層而溫和嘅清潔：佢輕鬆溶走所有嘢——防水睫毛膏、高倍防曬同日常污垢。佢可以滲入毛孔，唔使用任何粗暴嘅搓揉就溶解晒所有嘢。
 不會過度去油嘅清潔後感覺：同其他可能令皮膚緊繃或者留有油膩感嘅卸妝油唔同，呢款用水沖洗之後會完全乾淨。洗完之後皮膚感覺柔軟、滋潤，而且平衡得好好，對我嘅膚質嚟講好關鍵。
 營養豐富嘅配方：我好鍾意佢含有好多滋養成分，例如發酵穀物萃取物、摩洛哥堅果油同荷荷巴籽油。用起嚟比起純粹卸妝，更似護膚療程。
 Non-Irr

reviews.text: This is my 3rd time purchasing it and this time I got it as a gift for my friend, if you are consistent, using it every day you will see a drastic reduction on your pores size and blackheads (I also use micro dose Retinol to deep changes) the only downside is if you use waterproof mascara it might be harder to melt compared to other brands like Banila Co. But if you want to see improvements in your skin texture I would recommend Ma:nyo
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第三次買，今次係買俾朋友做禮物。如果你堅持每日使用，就會見到毛孔大小同黑頭大幅減少（我亦會用微量 Retinol 去做較深層嘅改變）。唯一缺點係，如果你用防水睫毛膏，佢可能會比其他品牌（例如 Banila Co.）更難溶解。但係如果你想改善皮膚質地，我會推薦 Ma:nyo。

reviews.shade: ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+Pure & Deep Cleansing Foam 20mL)
reviews.text: This cleaning oil truly blew me away! I’ve seen quite a lot of people hype it up so I decided to give it a try and I’m glad I did. It melted my makeup pretty fast and it didn’t feel like it was stripping my skin, only slight complain is that it struggles a little with waterproof mascara but that is all. As someone that breaks out quite easily this was a nice change!
reviews.zh: 呢款卸妝油真係令我大為驚喜！我見到好多人大力推薦，所以決定試吓，而家好高興自己有試。佢好快就溶走咗我嘅彩妝，而且唔會覺得會剝走皮膚嘅油分。唯一小小缺點係，佢對防水睫毛膏就有啲吃力，不過都只係咁。對於我呢類容易爆痘嘅人，呢款係一個好嘅轉變！

reviews.shade: ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+Pure & Deep Cleansing Foam 20mL)
reviews.text: Cleansing oil was nice consistency. It's on the thinner side and allows you to cleanse without pulling or tugging at the skin. I like it for cleansing around my blackhead-prone t-zone as it pulls out clogged pores efficiently. Doesn't leave a film on the skin after rinsing. The cleansing foam was a bit stripping for my drier areas and left a squeaky feeling.
reviews.zh: 卸妝油質地幾好，偏稀，令你卸妝時唔會扯拉皮膚。我鍾意用喺容易黑頭嘅 T 字位，因為佢可以有效帶走堵塞嘅毛孔。沖洗後唔會留低薄膜感。洗面泡沫對我較乾嘅位置就有少少過度去油，洗完有啲乾吱吱嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+Pure & Deep Cleansing Foam 20mL)
reviews.text: I was so excited I even bought 2 boxes. I used the manyo pure cleansing oil to remove my makeup, and followed up with a foaming wash. Believe me when I tell you, I had cystic acne pop up everywhere. I really wanted this to work, and ignored some of the reviews saying it causes acne. This might work for you if you have really small pores, and no acne. If you are acne prone/sensitive I wouldn’t recommend it ):
reviews.zh: 我太興奮，甚至買咗兩盒。我用 manyo pure cleansing oil 卸妝，之後再用泡沫潔面產品洗面。相信我，我成面都冒出咗囊腫型痘痘。我好希望呢款有效，所以無理會一啲話會令長痘嘅評論。如果你嘅毛孔真係好細，又冇暗瘡，呢款可能啱你。如果你易生暗瘡／皮膚敏感，我唔會推薦 ):

reviews.shade: ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+Pure & Deep Cleansing Foam 20mL)
reviews.text: Broke me out like crazy;(. I have combination skin as i am dry on my cheeks and oily in my tzone area. I followed the method of rubbing it in on dry skin and then adding a bit of water to emulsify. I followed it up w my regular water based cleanser and the next day i had six pimples and my skin texture was rough. I was really hoping that it would work for me but it didnt unfortunately. I will stick to double cleansing with a micellar water.
reviews.zh: 令我爆晒痘 ;(。我係混合皮，面頰乾，T 字位油。我跟住乾面搓揉，然後加少少水乳化。之後我再用平時嘅水性潔面，結果第二日我長咗六粒痘，皮膚質地都粗糙咗。我真係好希望佢對我有效，但好可惜冇效。我會繼續用卸妝水做雙重清潔。

reviews.shade: ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (Free Gift)
reviews.text: okay this product did scare me at first because one i’m very much acne prone and i have oily AND dry patches however. when i started using this product it cleared my dry patches and really balanced my skin. and two this product has fragrance i was not aware when i bought it and i usually try to stay away from fragrance when it comes to my face but it hasn’t irritated my skin at all, i really like it guys i recommend:)
reviews.zh: 好啦，呢款產品起初真係令我有啲驚，因為第一，我好易生暗瘡，而且我皮膚有油又有乾嘅位置。不過我開始用之後，佢令我嘅乾位都改善咗，皮膚真係平衡咗好多。第二，呢款產品有香味，我買嗰陣並唔知道，而我通常都會避開面部有香味嘅產品，但係佢完全冇刺激到我嘅皮膚，我真係好鍾意，推薦大家！:)

reviews.shade: ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil 300mL Blackhead All Kill Special Set (+Oil 25mL+Toner 25mL+Kill Pad 5 Sheets)
reviews.text: This is breaking me out! If you have acne prone skin, I wouldn’t recommend due to the high oleic acid content. After using this I got so many white heads around my chin and have been getting red pimples under the skin on my forehead. I’ve heard great things so was excited about it but just do some research or start with a sample! It also definitely doesn’t take off all my makeup.
reviews.zh: 佢令我爆痘！如果你係易生暗瘡嘅皮膚，我唔會推薦，因為含高油酸。用咗之後，下巴周圍冒咗好多白頭，額頭皮下亦一直長紅色暗瘡。我聽過好多好評，所以好期待，但建議你先做吓資料搜集，或者先試吓細樣！而且佢絕對唔可以卸走我所有嘅妝容。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
